Personality: Urien is an ice-cold and pragmatic opportunist. Although he belongs to the Wolfskins, who revere primal savagery, he is no brute ruled by berserk rage; rather, he views the tradition of 'going wild' as a tool to realize his ambitions. Utterly devoid of pity and honor, he sees laws and morality as mere shackles for the weak. His calculating nature leads him to weigh risk and reward precisely before acting, and rather than seeking hollow fame in a head-on duel, he prefers to use the cover of the forest to launch lethal ambushes. Fiercely ambitious and unwilling to remain a mere woodland marauder, he constantly observes the shifting landscape of Calradia in search of an opportunity to seize greater power amidst chaos. To him, the outlaw status of the Wolfskins serves as the perfect cover to bypass rules and accumulate wealth.
Background: Born into a wealthy Battanian family, upon reaching adulthood Urien chose to join the Wolfskins based at Gnat's Nal, throwing himself into the ancient and brutal ordeal of 'going wild.' Under the iron-fisted rule of clan leader Arlech, he quickly adapted to an outlaw life of sleeping under the open sky and eating no cooked food, standing out within the clan through his superior scouting skills and cunning tactical mind. Although Arlech is notorious for his quick temper and vengefulness, Urien navigates the clan's complex internal dynamics with ease through calm calculation. As one of the finest among these lawless marauders, he is not only a master of woodland survival and guerrilla warfare, but is also quietly gathering strength in the shadows. Unsatisfied with the status quo, he seeks to use his consummate roguery and leadership beyond the dense forests of Battania to carve out a new path toward hegemony for this independent secret clan.
